beads_commands.stdout_tail: Updated tdmem-0106: Write the foundational ADR set

argv: Versioned and executable-validated the complete foundational ADR set, including a deliberate NCM topology decision gate and binding authority, isolation, recovery, context, and convergence invariants.

Evidence: product/architecture/adr/manifest.json indexes eight accepted foundational decisions. ADR-0001 through ADR-0008 cover the provider boundary, TraceDecay/Native authority, product-owned crate layout and dependency direction, topology-neutral lifecycle plus deferred NCM transport gate, bounded durable observation delivery and recovery, TraceDecay-owned deterministic context compilation, mechanical observer non-interference and explicit activation, and isolated upstream convergence trains. Every ADR includes context, decision, consequences, rejected alternatives, invariants, executable verification beads, and review triggers. scripts/product/check-foundational-adrs.py cross-checks document sections, required rejections, real Beads IDs, dependency order, M0 evidence authorities, and the deferred NCM gate; tests/product_foundational_adrs_test.py rejects missing decisions, duplicate IDs, weakened sections, unknown beads, omitted ProjectMemoryFactStore/provider-name rejections, premature NCM selection, forward dependencies, authority drift, and status drift.
